data.name: A Knight of the Broken Crown
data.original_name: A Knight of the Broken Crown
data.overview: A wandering hedge knight and his young squire travel through a realm still haunted by a civil war. Their modest errands bring them face to face with the great houses, where loyalty is tested long before either can imagine wearing a crown.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The story expands as old choices return and new alliances begin to take shape.
